name: New RUN Key Pointing to Suspicious Folder
description: Detects suspicious new RUN key element pointing to an executable in a suspicious folder
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Software using weird folders for updates
query: (registry.path:(*\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run* OR *\\Software\\WOW6432Node\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run* OR *\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\Explorer\\Run*)) AND ((winlog.event_data.Details:(*\:\\Perflogs* OR *\:\\ProgramData'* OR *\:\\Windows\\Temp* OR *\:\\Temp* OR *\\AppData\\Local\\Temp* OR *\\AppData\\Roaming* OR *\:\\$Recycle.bin* OR *\:\\Users\\Default* OR *\:\\Users\\public* OR *%temp%* OR *%tmp%* OR *%Public%* OR *%AppData%*)) OR (winlog.event_data.Details:*\:\\Users\\* AND (winlog.event_data.Details:(*\\Favorites* OR *\\Favourites* OR *\\Contacts* OR *\\Music* OR *\\Pictures* OR *\\Documents* OR *\\Photos*)))) AND (NOT (registry.path:*\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\RunOnce\\* AND process.executable:C\:\\Windows\\SoftwareDistribution\\Download\\* AND (winlog.event_data.Details:*rundll32.exe\ * AND winlog.event_data.Details:*C\:\\WINDOWS\\system32\\advpack.dll,DelNodeRunDLL32*) AND (winlog.event_data.Details:(*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\* OR *C\:\\Windows\\Temp\\*))))
